sloka: बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यमतेर्वचस्त ।न्निशम्य यत्नेन विभीषणस्य ।ततो महात्मा वचनम् बभाषे ।तत्रेन्द्रजिन्नैरृतयूथमुख्यः ॥६-१५-१॥।।
transliteration: bṛhaspatestulyamatervacasta ।nniśamya yatnena vibhīṣaṇasya ।tato mahātmā vacanam babhāṣe ।tatrendrajinnairṛtayūthamukhyaḥ ॥6-15-1॥।।

translations.english: Thus spoke Indrajith, the great leader of the Rakshasa army, having heard the words spoken by the highly intelligent Vibheeshana who was equal to Brhaspathi in wisdom.
